youtube_title: Ate Momos Last Night? Now Bloated? Don't Lie Down | Body Fix #2 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #2. One plate of momos at night... and now your stomach's a FOOTBALL?
B is right. A slow 10-15 min walk. Moving helps trapped gas pass.
Heavy, oily, late food digests slowly, and gas gets trapped. That's the bloat.
Fix: Warm water in the morning, light food today, no fizzy drinks or gum.
Red flags: Severe pain, vomiting, fever, or bloated most days? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Bloating
